title: Measured solid fraction from a GPU field sample overrides the model's volume fraction
context: After the search, 20-predictor.js shapeCheck() measures the best 16 designs' solid fraction on a 48³ grid over one cell using the preview's field (25-raymarch.js), replaces predicted volume fraction, and cuts confidence when the model was off by more than 2σ (low past 3σ). Recipes record it under synth.measured.

options.name: Fixed 48³ GPU sample of the top 16 (current)
options.summary: Same field as the preview and F13LD.mesh; one grid size for all modes.
pros: Volume-fraction targets scored on the real shape
Catches model errors far from data (4.5% vs 20.6% case)
cons: Thin PI-TPMS pipes may be under-sampled

options.name: Adaptive or finer grid for PI-TPMS
options.summary: Sample finer where walls or pipes are thin.
cons: More GPU time; needs a thickness heuristic

options.name: Treat the check as advisory only
options.summary: Show the measured value but keep the model's for scoring.
cons: Ranks designs on a number known to be wrong

recommendation: Approved by Matt in v0.4.1 (recap "Shape check"); README "Shape check"; 20-predictor.js shapeCheck and 12-search-core.js shapeCheck.
strain: In the Mesh check every PI-TPMS design built 2 to 4 points thinner than predicted; whether the model or the 48³ sampling is wrong is an open hand check in docs/NEXT-UP.md.
